question: Where inside the first Decode token does the high-load TTFT jump observed by HIGH_LOAD_TTFT_DIAG_v1 occur?

reference.instrumentation: record request.location_history for the first Decode iteration without altering scheduling

execution_amendment.reason: The first instrumented attempt completed the first three frozen physical runs and then stopped because the script incorrectly asserted that the focus request must also be the maximum-TTFT request at the lower-load comparison point. That assertion is not part of the scientific protocol: the focus request is frozen from the high-load failure and is intentionally followed backward to the lower-load point.

measurements: time spent at source, links, and each compute node during first Decode
per-node first-Decode residence increase from lower-load to high-load for the same request
decision_boundary: Do not choose or tune a protection mechanism from this stage trace alone. Use it only to identify whether the missing time is compute-node residence/queueing, network transfer, or another location.
